info.name: Tempo
info.description: Tempo is a hero character known for their ability to manipulate time and speed.
info.lore: Tempo is the latest hero made in Unia designed with a new discovered technology. The time manipulation allowed Tempo to escape a surprise attacks from an unknown enemy. Now Tempo's mission is to find the others heroes and find out who is behind the attack.

characteristics.body: Tempo's body is slim and helps her move quickly. Her chest contains a clockwork mechanism that indicates her time manipulation abilities. Her limbs are designed for agility and speed, with reinforced joints and lightweight materials.

outfit.description: Tempo's costume helps her maintain her speed and agility, featuring a tight-fitting suit with aerodynamic designs and a visor that enhances her perception of time.

hidden.realLore: Tempo is a dead girl that was exposed to the Catarsys and had her brain recovered, but her body was already lost. The government used the technology to create a body for her and she discovered her abilities with it, but lost all other memories. Tempo now fights with a new purpose, knowing that she was given a new life.

abilities.name: No time to waste!
abilities.description: Tempo increases their own speed, granting increased attack speed, movement speed and cooldown reduction for a duration.

abilities.name: Relax!
abilities.description: Tempo decreases the speed of enemies in an area around them, decreasing their attack speed, movement speed and cooldown reduction for a duration.

abilities.name: Fast and Furious!
abilities.description: Tempo travels through enemies enemies close to each other, attacking each of them with increased damage and landing behind the last enemy attacked.
